prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no lyrics. Medieval chiptune. 8-bit console sound playing early music: a square-wave lead that phrases like a recorder or a shawm, a plucked pulse-wave lute arpeggio, a triangle-wave drone like a hurdy-gurdy, noise-channel tabor drum and tambourine. Modal melody in Dorian or Mixolydian, an estampie or a galliard dance feel, a castle court, minstrels, a tournament. Crunchy retro chip timbres, no modern synth pads, no orchestra. Background music for the battle phase of a cheerful castle board game: toy cannons pop like a fairground shooting gallery, water splashes, ships tip over like toys, nothing grim. Tempo: 150 BPM. Mood: driving, exciting, playful, heroic. Arrangement: a field-drum march pattern throughout, a fanfare-like main theme in the lead, a running bass, a second section with more tension, back to the theme, no slow intro, no ending, constant energy so it loops. About 90 seconds long.
